BNTAlgebraTensorClause.lean: BNT algebra clause structure extending CPSVVerticalDecomposition with coefficient families
IdentityTensor.lean: Identity MPO tensor definition and mpo_idTensor theorem
Boundary.lean: Commuting boundary algebra and IsMPDOWithBoundary predicate citing arXiv:2504.16985
Simple.lean: Definition 4.7 simplicity predicate and IsSimpleCanonicalForm.isSimple theorem
AlgebraStructure.lean: AlgebraStructureData structure and HasBlockedAdjointFixedPointAlgebraTower with diagonal chi families
AreaLaw.lean: Saturation of area law (IsSAL) definitions for MPDO and MPS with mutual information
ZCL.lean: Zero correlation length definitions (IsZCL, IsSourceZCL, physTraceTransfer) with scope restriction notes
CPSVExample410CorrelatedFlip.lean: Exact entropy calculations for Example 4.10 with mutual information defect proof
summary: Inspected 10 representative files from the TNLean/MPS/MPDO directory (Defs.lean, ActionTensor.lean, BNTAlgebraTensorClause.lean, IdentityTensor.lean, Boundary.lean, Simple.lean, AlgebraStructure.lean, AreaLaw.lean, ZCL.lean, CPSVExample410CorrelatedFlip.lean, CZXTensor.lean, Theorem49RepeatedCopyCounterexample.lean, VerticalCF.lean, PhysicalBlocking.lean, CompleteZipperFusion.lean, InverseMapActiveSectorPrimitivity.lean, BiCFDerivation/Core.lean, CPSVBlockingChannelCounterexample.lean). All contain formal mathematical definitions, theorems, and proofs with explicit paper references (primarily arXiv:1606.00608). No files are pure imports, documentation-only, or otherwise lacking formal content. The entire unit consists of core formalization of matrix product density operator theory.
